pool.text: Ohinemutu was invaded by a coalition commanded by Hongi Hika and Pomare I.
Thomas Chapman and his wife established a mission at Te Koutu.
The Ngati Whakaue people leased 50 acres to the Crown under the Fenton Agreement.
The Pink and White Terraces were destroyed by the eruption of Mount Tarawera.
The town connected to Auckland with the opening of the Rotorua Branch railway.
The last horse-drawn coach completed its final journey in the transport network.
Rotorua was elevated to the status of a borough.
Local transport operators formed a consortium known as the Rotorua Bus Co.
Edwin Robertson died at the age of seventy-four after running transport services.
Rotorua was declared a city forty years after becoming a borough.
The Crown settled a Treaty of Waitangi claim with the Ngati Whakaue people.
The Whakarewarewa forest hosted the UCI Mountain Bike and Trials World Championships.
Rotorua hosted the World Waterski Championships using the local lakes as venues.
Steve Chadwick was elected Mayor of Rotorua during the local municipal elections.
The International Mountain Biking Association listed Rotorua among top global destinations.
Bee Cards were introduced for public transport fare payments across services.
Tania Tapsell was elected to serve as the Mayor of Rotorua.
The gross domestic product of the Rotorua District reached four thousand million dollars.
Te Puia received the supreme winner award at the New Zealand Tourism Awards.
